usedFor: ikas holds store orders and customers, and Brevo gets each “New Customer” on a list through “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in ikas, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Each new customer joins a chosen list, so your email lists grow without exports.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” works on existing contacts, so the customer must already be in Brevo.
